T: Hottest day of the year. Coldest drinks in the house.
D: Tensions boil over at Sal's pizzeria on the hottest day of a Brooklyn summer.
P: Turn the fan on and pour the drinks when Mookie makes his first delivery.
S: the wall of fame watches you eat
Strips of pizza dough tied in knots, proved 30 minutes, baked at 230C for 12 minutes, tossed hot in garlic butter, parsley and parmesan.
chilli salt, the only cool thing on the block
Watermelon chilled for hours, cut into wedges, sprinkled at the table with a mix of flaky salt, chilli flakes and lime zest.
for when the fire hydrant gets opened
Blend watermelon with lime juice and a little sugar syrup, strain, pour into moulds with sticks and freeze at least 6 hours.
M: pepperoni and extra cheese, straight from the wall of fame
New York pie on a hot steel at max heat: thin sauce, low-moisture mozzarella, pepperoni, oregano. Cut big.
ham and provolone, the corner men's lunch
Long roll split, leg ham and sharp provolone layered, shredded lettuce, tomato and onion, dressed with olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.

Shave or crush ice into cups, soak with homemade cherry syrup: cherries simmered with sugar and lemon, strained.

edition.tagline: Hottest day of the year. Coldest drinks in the house.
edition.cue: Turn the fan on and pour the drinks when Mookie makes his first delivery.

s.note: Pizza dough knots tossed hot in garlic butter, parsley and parmesan.
s.how: Cut 500g pizza dough into 12 strips, tie each into a knot and prove 30 minutes. Bake at 230C for 12 minutes until golden. Melt 50g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and chopped parsley, toss the hot knots through and shower with 30g grated parmesan.

s.note: Ice-cold watermelon with chilli, lime and salt at the table.
s.how: Chill a quarter watermelon, about 2kg, for several hours. Cut into wedges. Mix 1 tsp sea salt flakes, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes and the zest of 1 lime in a little bowl and sprinkle over at the table, with lime wedges to squeeze.

m.note: Big thin New York slices with mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano.
m.how: Rest 2 balls of pizza dough, about 500g, at room temperature for an hour. Season 400g crushed tomatoes with salt and stretch the bases thin. Spread with sauce, top with 250g grated low-moisture mozzarella and 100g pepperoni and bake on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting for 8 to 10 minutes. Sprinkle with oregano and cut big.

w.note: Crushed ice soaked with homemade cherry syrup.
w.how: Simmer 300g cherries, pitted, with 150g caster sugar, 150ml water and the juice of 1 lemon for 10 minutes, then strain and cool the syrup. Shave or crush 1kg ice into four cups and pour the syrup over just before serving.

d.note: American lager frozen cold, straight from the bottle.
d.how: Put four 355ml bottles of American lager in the freezer for 25 minutes, no longer, so they are ice cold but not frozen. Serve straight from the bottle on a hot night.
